name: Itsuwari no Alkanet
source:
The story takes place in the Taisho period, during the political crisis that would lead to the end of Japan’s oligarchy and the rise of the democratic parties. After all the political turmoil, the Takatori family is finally recovering its lost peace. Takatori’s sucessor is the aspiring Pianist Yuto, whose piano skills keep evolving along with his plans to study abroad. Everything looks favorable, but things are about to get clouded…

[from [url=http://nitrochi-paths.tumblr.com/post/105039397718/false-alkanet]Nitro+Chiral Paths[/url]]

Mobile game released as a collaboration between Nitro+Chiral (under the name CHiRAL Mobile) and Digiturbo. Can only be played on Japanese phones, not much is known about this title.
translation:
故事发生在大正时代，正值政治危机时期，之后日本的寡头政治将走向终结，民主政党开始崛起。

经历政治动荡后，高取家终于逐渐恢复了失去的和平。高取家的继承人是雄心勃勃的钢琴家优斗，他的钢琴技艺和留学计划一同不断发展。

一切看起来都很顺利，但阴云即将笼罩这一切……

[来自 [url=http://nitrochi-paths.tumblr.com/post/105039397718/false-alkanet]Nitro+Chiral Paths[/url]]

这是 Nitro+Chiral（以 CHiRAL Mobile 名义）与 Digiturbo 合作发布的手机游戏。只能在日本手机上游玩，目前关于本作的资料很少。
